name: What should I consider before starting a kitchen renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before starting a kitchen renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting, consider your functional needs and aesthetic preferences. Think about how you use your kitchen daily, what frustrates you about the current layout, and what improvements would enhance your lifestyle. It's helpful to gather inspiration photos and create a wish list, distinguishing between 'must-haves' and 'nice-to-haves.' Having a clear vision and an estimated budget range prepared will significantly streamline the initial consultation and design phase with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before starting, consider your kitchen's functional needs, desired aesthetics, and prepare a wish list and budget to guide the renovation process.
